task_summary: Find the radius from sector area and central angle
method_path: Substitute area and angle into A = (1/2)r^2 theta; isolate r^2; take the positive square root

task_summary: Find the perimeter of the sector
method_path: Compute arc length r theta; add two radii

task_summary: Find the intersection probability from two marginals and a union
method_path: Use P(A union B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A intersection B); rearrange

task_summary: Find a conditional probability involving complements
method_path: Find P(A' intersection B') from the complement of the union; divide by P(B')

task_summary: Prove an algebraic expression is divisible by 12
method_path: Apply difference of squares; simplify to 24n; factor as 12(2n)

task_summary: Find an exact half-angle cosine from the three sides of a triangle
method_path: Use cosine rule to find cos(2 theta); apply cos(2 theta) = 2cos^2(theta) - 1; choose the positive root; simplify the radical

task_summary: Determine which term of an arithmetic sequence equals zero
method_path: Form equations from u10 and S25; solve for first term and common difference; solve uk = 0

task_summary: Solve a quadratic inequality
method_path: Find both critical roots; use the sign of the upward-opening quadratic between the roots

task_summary: Choose the largest domain endpoint for which the inverse exists
method_path: Locate the vertex; restrict the quadratic to a one-to-one branch ending at the vertex; justify with monotonicity or the horizontal line test

task_summary: Determine the range of a transformed secant function on a closed interval
method_path: Evaluate the transformed secant at endpoints and its minimum; state the closed range

task_summary: Find a volume formed by rotating the region under a secant curve
method_path: Set up V = pi integral f(x)^2 dx; integrate sec^2 using tan; evaluate the bounds

task_summary: Express the position vector of a point dividing a segment
method_path: Write OP = OA + lambda AB; replace AB by b - a; collect coefficients

task_summary: Find the division parameter when two vectors are perpendicular
method_path: Set OP dot AB = 0; expand using a dot b, |a|^2 and |b|^2; solve the resulting linear equation for lambda
accepted_alternatives: Cosine rule followed by two Pythagorean equations

task_summary: Prove a trigonometric identity involving tan(pi/4 - theta) and double angles
method_path: Expand tan(pi/4 - theta); express in sine and cosine; multiply by the conjugate; use sin(2 theta) and cos(2 theta)
accepted_alternatives: Sine and cosine subtraction formulae|Work entirely in tan(theta)

task_summary: Solve a trigonometric equation using the identity proved above
method_path: Set theta = 2x; transform the equation to tan(pi/4 - 2x) = 3; solve the tangent equation; retain solutions in the domain

task_summary: Derive the total surface area of a hollow cylinder
method_path: Add outer and inner curved areas and two annular end areas; simplify

task_summary: Derive volume as a function of radius under a fixed surface-area constraint
method_path: Use the surface-area constraint to express h or rh in terms of r; subtract cylinder volumes; substitute and simplify to V(r)

task_summary: Differentiate the volume function
method_path: Differentiate V(r) term by term

task_summary: Find the radius parameter that maximizes volume
method_path: Set dV/dr = 0 for the maximum; solve for r; compare with the required radical form

task_summary: Evaluate the maximum volume exactly
method_path: Substitute the maximizing radius into V(r); simplify to the requested exact form

task_summary: Evaluate a limit of a quotient of exponential expressions
method_path: Differentiate numerator and denominator using l'Hopital; simplify the quotient and take the limit
accepted_alternatives: Divide numerator and denominator by the dominant exponential

task_summary: Differentiate an exponential quotient and rewrite the derivative in terms of y
method_path: Apply the quotient rule; simplify; independently compute 1 - y^2 as a common fraction; identify it with dy/dx

task_summary: Obtain second and third derivatives in terms of y
method_path: Differentiate the relation y' = 1 - y^2 implicitly; substitute y'; differentiate again and substitute previous relations

task_summary: Construct a Maclaurin series through the cubic term
method_path: Evaluate y, y', y'' and y''' at zero; insert them into the Maclaurin formula through x^3

task_summary: Find all fourth roots of a complex number in polar form
method_path: Write 16i in modulus-argument form; take the fourth root of the modulus; enumerate four arguments separated by pi/2

task_summary: Find the common ratio of the complex-root sequence
method_path: Divide consecutive roots in polar form; subtract arguments; convert cis(pi/2) to i

task_summary: Plot the four roots on an Argand diagram
method_path: Plot equal moduli with angular separation pi/2 in the correct quadrants

task_summary: Determine the equation whose roots are the conjugates of the original roots
method_path: Conjugate the relation z^4 = 16i or raise a conjugate root to the fourth power; identify a and b
accepted_alternatives: Use the product of conjugate roots

task_summary: Find the least power whose roots include the side midpoints on the Argand diagram
method_path: Find midpoint modulus and argument; require p times the argument to be a multiple of 2pi; choose the least p; compute q from the modulus

task_summary: Evaluate a function at both domain endpoints
method_path: Enter the function in the GDC and evaluate f(0) and f(20)

task_summary: Find two numerical roots of a function
method_path: Use a numerical solver or graph intersections to obtain both roots

task_summary: Sketch a function from endpoints, roots and a maximum
method_path: Plot the two endpoints and roots; locate the maximum numerically; draw the correct smooth shape

task_summary: Find one coefficient in a binomial expansion
method_path: Write the general term; choose r so the power is x^6; evaluate the binomial coefficient and constants

task_summary: Normalize a discrete probability distribution
method_path: Set the sum of all probabilities equal to 1; solve for k

task_summary: Find the expected value of a discrete random variable
method_path: Substitute the normalized probabilities into E(X) = sum xP(X=x); evaluate

task_summary: Find a roof angle from a given gradient
method_path: Interpret the gradient as rise/run; use tangent with the complementary angle; convert to degrees

task_summary: Find two roof lengths from symmetry and right-triangle geometry
method_path: Use symmetry to halve the 700 cm span; find the diagonal rise/length by sine or Pythagoras; add the 50 cm offset; use the slope ratio for the remaining segment

task_summary: Find parameter values for which a logarithm is defined for every real x
method_path: Require the quadratic argument to be positive for all real x; impose discriminant < 0; solve the resulting quadratic inequality in r
accepted_alternatives: Analyze the minimum of the quadratic

task_summary: Find the expectation of a piecewise continuous random variable
method_path: Set up integral x f(x) over each interval; evaluate and add

task_summary: Use a linear transformation of expectation to find a constant
method_path: Use E(c - 2X) = c - 2E(X); set equal to zero; solve for c

task_summary: Find the median of a piecewise continuous distribution
method_path: Use accumulated probability to locate the interval containing the median; set the CDF equal to 0.5; solve for m

task_summary: Count seatings in which three named people are not consecutive
method_path: Count all ordered placements of the three people; subtract arrangements where they occupy one consecutive block

task_summary: Count seatings of six people with three named people consecutive
method_path: Place and internally arrange the block of three; arrange the other three people in remaining seats; multiply
accepted_alternatives: Treat the block and three people as four ordered items

task_summary: Prove the product of a complex number and its conjugate equals its squared modulus
method_path: Write w = x + iy; multiply by x - iy; identify x^2 + y^2 as |w|^2

task_summary: Eliminate a complex variable using a modulus condition and solve for z
method_path: Multiply the first equation by w; use ww* = |w|^2 and zw from the second equation; isolate z; simplify to Cartesian form
accepted_alternatives: Substitute w* from one equation into the other

task_summary: Find the parameter range for convergence of a geometric sum
method_path: Identify the common ratio; require |r| < 1; solve the logarithmic inequality for c and exclude the stated forbidden value

task_summary: Find the least n for which a geometric-series remainder is below a tolerance
method_path: Compute S_infinity; form |S_infinity - S_n| < 0.1; solve numerically for n; round up to the least integer
accepted_alternatives: Use the closed form for the remainder

task_summary: Fit and interpret a linear population model
method_path: Use GDC linear regression to obtain slope and intercept; interpret slope as average population increase per year

task_summary: Assess reliability of a model prediction outside the data range
method_path: Compare the prediction year with the observed data interval; identify extrapolation as unreliable

task_summary: Evaluate and interpret an exponential population model
method_path: Substitute t = 100; interpret 1.005 as a 0.5 percent annual growth factor

task_summary: Evaluate a second nonlinear population model
method_path: Substitute t = 100 into Cecilia's model and evaluate

task_summary: Find when two model predictions differ most
method_path: Form B(t) - C(t) or its absolute equivalent; use GDC optimization over the stated domain; convert t to calendar year
accepted_alternatives: Solve derivative of the difference equal to zero

task_summary: Evaluate derivatives of two population models at a given time
method_path: Differentiate each model or use GDC numerical derivative; evaluate both at t = 75

task_summary: Compare and interpret two model derivatives
method_path: Compare the numerical derivatives; state which model predicts faster population growth in 2075

task_summary: Convert a Cartesian line equation into vector-parametric form
method_path: Set the symmetric ratios equal to a parameter; solve for x, y and z; collect into r = a + lambda b

task_summary: Find the minimum distance from the origin to a line
method_path: Parameterize a point on the line; form its distance from the origin; minimize over the parameter
accepted_alternatives: Perpendicular dot product|Cross-product point-to-line distance formula

task_summary: Verify that a plane contains a line
method_path: Substitute the parametric coordinates of the line into the plane equation and simplify to an identity
accepted_alternatives: Show direction is perpendicular to the plane normal and one point lies in the plane

task_summary: Find a line through a point that intersects the z-axis and is parallel to a plane
method_path: Represent the z-axis intersection as (0,0,z); form the direction from the given point; impose direction dot plane normal = 0; solve for z; write the line equation
accepted_alternatives: Start with an unknown direction and impose both intersection and parallelism conditions

task_summary: Differentiate a rational function with a parameter
method_path: Apply quotient rule carefully; expand and collect the numerator into the required form

task_summary: Find parameter values for which stationary points exist
method_path: Set the derivative numerator equal to zero; require real roots using its discriminant; solve the inequality in positive k

task_summary: Identify the vertical asymptote of a rational function
method_path: Set the denominator equal to zero for k = 2

task_summary: Find the oblique asymptote of a rational function
method_path: Divide numerator by denominator; retain the linear quotient and show the remainder term tends to zero
accepted_alternatives: Compare coefficients of an assumed linear asymptote

task_summary: Prove the derivative is greater than 2 throughout its domain
method_path: Rewrite y' as 2 + 7/(x+2)^2; note the second term is strictly positive on the domain

task_summary: Sketch a rational curve using its asymptotes and derivative information
method_path: Draw both branches relative to the vertical and oblique asymptotes; use y' > 2 to preserve increasing behaviour

task_summary: Verify the second term of a recurrence model
method_path: Substitute T1 into T2 = 1.1T1 - 500 and simplify

task_summary: Verify the third term of the recurrence
method_path: Substitute T2 into the recurrence and simplify

task_summary: Find the fourth term of the recurrence
method_path: Substitute T3 into the recurrence and evaluate

task_summary: Simplify a supplied explicit expression for the recurrence
method_path: Eliminate the denominator 0.1; collect coefficients of (1.1)^(n-1); obtain the required closed form

task_summary: Find a later term from the explicit model
method_path: Substitute n = 6 into the closed form and round to the nearest whole number

task_summary: Derive the first difference of an explicit sequence
method_path: Form D_(n+1) - D_n; substitute both explicit terms; factor powers of 1.1; simplify
accepted_alternatives: Use the recurrence to express the difference in terms of D_n

task_summary: Deduce that the sequence is strictly decreasing
method_path: Observe that -150(1.1)^(n-1) is negative; conclude D_(n+1) < D_n

task_summary: Determine when the modeled population first becomes non-positive
method_path: Solve D_n <= 0 using logarithms or a numerical threshold; distinguish start-of-year index from the year during which removal occurs
accepted_alternatives: Trial and improvement|Graphical solution|Sum of first differences

task_summary: Choose annual removal so the modeled sequence is constant
method_path: Rewrite C_n as (6000 - 10d)(1.1)^(n-1) + 10d; set the exponential coefficient to zero; solve for d
accepted_alternatives: Set C_(n+1) - C_n = 0|Set C2 = C1 in the recurrence

task_summary: Prove the explicit formula for a first-order linear recurrence
method_path: Verify n = 1; assume the formula at n = k; substitute it into u_(k+1) = r u_k - d; simplify to the k+1 form; conclude by induction

task_summary: Find exact roots of a palindromic quadratic
method_path: Apply the quadratic formula or complete the square; retain exact roots -2 +/- sqrt(3)

task_summary: Show the two real roots are reciprocals
method_path: Multiply the exact roots and show the product is 1
accepted_alternatives: Take the reciprocal of one root|Use Vieta's product

task_summary: Show the complex roots of x^2 + 1 are reciprocals
method_path: Identify roots i and -i; show their product is 1 or that 1/i = -i

task_summary: Verify the reciprocal identity for a palindromic quadratic
method_path: Evaluate p(1/x); multiply by x^2; simplify back to p(x)

task_summary: Prove that a nonzero root of a palindromic polynomial implies its reciprocal is a root
method_path: Substitute root alpha into p(alpha) = alpha^n p(1/alpha); use alpha != 0 to conclude p(1/alpha) = 0

task_summary: Prove the product of two palindromic polynomials is palindromic
method_path: Substitute the reciprocal identities for p and q into f = pq; combine powers to x^(n+m); identify the degree n+m

task_summary: Determine two parameters in a factorization of a palindromic quartic
method_path: Expand the quadratic product; compare x^3 and x^2 coefficients to form equations in u and v; solve respecting u < v
accepted_alternatives: Polynomial division|Evaluate the identity at two chosen x-values

task_summary: Find all exact real and complex roots of the palindromic quartic
method_path: Use the factorization from part (f); solve each quadratic exactly; list two real and two complex roots

task_summary: Prove that every odd-degree palindromic polynomial has root -1
method_path: Evaluate p(-1); pair symmetric coefficients with opposite signs; use odd degree to show complete cancellation
accepted_alternatives: Use reciprocal-root pairing and the product of roots|Apply p(x) = x^n p(1/x) at x = -1
